label: Defined: P.Defined m: an ecumenical council of the practice defines m, condemning its denial by…
term: defined (by a council of the practice)
definition: `P.Defined m`: an ecumenical council of the practice defines m, condemning its denial by canon (anathema sit).
note: Stipulated as the form of Dei Filius's canons; whether such a definition belongs to the practice's grammar is the open bridge STMT-CONCILIAR-DEFINITION-IS-PRACTICE-OWN-STANDARD, not part of this sense.

formal_gap.meaning: Practice.Defined m says that an ecumenical council of the practice defines the move m, condemning its denial by canon (anathema sit). It is a field of a religious practice viewed as a language game (TruthCore.Alternatives.Fideism, #1010), supplied by each model. It records the conciliar form of a move, not that the move is correct or that the practice counts it as its own standard.
examples: The Vatican I canon condemning the denial that God can be known with certainty from created things by natural reason, read as a defined move of the Catholic practice.
exclusions: A teaching proposed without a canon condemning its denial.
Endorsement by the practice's own standards (OwnStandard): whether a conciliar definition is such an endorsement is the open bridge STMT-CONCILIAR-DEFINITION-IS-PRACTICE-OWN-STANDARD.
open_obligations: STMT-CONCILIAR-DEFINITION-IS-PRACTICE-OWN-STANDARD remains open; the descriptive-theology sibling readings are kept apart in DISAMB-THEOLOGICAL-FORMULATION-AND-NORMATIVE-GRAMMAR.
No formalization candidate: whether a council defined a move is a historical input to the model.
